title: What's Missing in Environmental Self-Monitoring: Evidence from Strategic Shutdowns of Pollution Monitors
abstract: Regulators often rely on regulated entities to self-monitor compliance, creating strategic incentives for endogenous monitoring. This paper builds a framework to detect whether local governments skip air pollution monitoring when they expect air quality to deteriorate. The core of our method tests whether the timing of monitor shutdowns coincides with the counties’ air quality alerts—public advisories based on local governments’ own pollution forecasts. Applying the method to a monitor in Jersey City, New Jersey, suspected of a deliberate shutdown during the 2013 “Bridgegate” traffic jam, we find a 33% reduction of this monitor's sampling rate on pollution-alert days. Building on large-scale inference tools, we then apply the method to test more than 1,300 monitors across the United States, finding fourteen metropolitan areas with clusters of monitors showing similar strategic behavior. We assess geometric imputation and remote-sensing technologies as potential solutions to deter future strategic monitoring.
abstract_zh: 监管者通常依赖受监管主体自我监测合规情况，这就产生了内生监测的战略激励。本文构建了一个框架，用以检测地方政府在预期空气质量会恶化时是否会跳过空气污染监测。我们方法的核心在于检验监测站关停的时间是否与各县的空气质量预警（即基于地方政府自身污染预报发布的公告）相吻合。我们将该方法应用于新泽西州泽西城的一个监测站，该站被怀疑在2013年的“桥门事件”（Bridgegate）交通堵塞期间被蓄意关停，结果发现，在污染预警日，该监测站的采样频率降低了33%。借助大规模推断工具，我们随后将该方法应用于美国1300多个监测站，发现有14个大都市区存在监测站集群表现出相似的战略性行为。我们评估了几何插补和遥感技术，作为遏制未来战略性监测的潜在解决方案。

title: Beyond New: Consumer Trading of Used Items
Coca's Return and the American Overdose Fallout
Does Urban Biodiversity Matter?
ESG Aversion: Experimental Evidence on Perceptions and Preferences
abstract: We develop an experimental framework to identify the belief-based and taste-based drivers of demand for Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) partnerships. Our study implements two symmetric experiments with real startup founders and venture capital (VC) investors, who evaluate hypothetical profiles under the understanding that their responses will inform an algorithm generating personalized real-world matches. We find a significant ESG penalty: profiles randomly labeled with ESG attributes receive substantially lower collaboration interest from both founders and VCs.This penalty is primarily driven by negative performance beliefs-ESG-labeled profiles are perceived as less profitable and less accessible. To isolate taste-based preferences, we further implement a willingness-to-pay experiment in which participants may forgo part of a lottery reward to receive additional match recommendations of comparable quality. Participants randomly offered ESG-oriented recommendations are now significantly more likely to pay, revealing a latent preference for ESG once performance concerns are held constant. These findings highlight a tension between financial returns and personal values: in current market conditions, concerns about profitability obscure an underlying taste for ESG.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个实验框架，以识别对环境、社会和治理（ESG）合作关系需求背后基于信念和基于偏好的驱动因素。我们的研究实施了两项对称实验，参与者为真实的初创企业创始人和风险投资（VC）投资者，他们在理解其回应将用于生成个性化现实匹配算法的前提下，对假设的企业资料进行评估。我们发现存在显著的ESG惩罚：随机贴上ESG标签的资料，获得创始人和风投的合作意向明显更低。这一惩罚主要由负面的业绩信念所驱动——被贴上ESG标签的资料被认为盈利能力更弱、更难获取。为了分离出基于偏好的因素，我们进一步实施了一项支付意愿实验，参与者可以放弃部分抽奖奖励，以换取质量相当的额外匹配推荐。随机获得ESG导向推荐的参与者，现在明显更有可能付费，这表明在控制业绩顾虑之后，存在潜在的ESG偏好。这些发现凸显了财务回报与个人价值观之间的张力：在当前市场条件下，对盈利能力的担忧掩盖了潜在的ESG偏好。

title: Healing Nature at Scale and Return: Lessons from China's Ecological Restoration
Measuring Neural Engagement in High-Stakes Trading
abstract: The emergence of wearable electroencephalography (EEG) technologies presents new opportunities to identify and quantify neural correlates of decision-making in real-time, financially consequential settings.We report a field study in which we use wearable EEG devices to record brainwave activity from professional day traders during real-world, high-stakes trading.Using these signals, we construct an established psychophysiological Engagement Index (EI), which is defined as beta wave power divided by the sum of alpha and theta wave power, and document clear spike-and-decay patterns around trade execution.Linking EI dynamics to trading performance, we find that more successful trades are preceded by larger EI spikes in the 30 seconds before execution, while baseline or background EI levels have no predictive power and, if anything, are negatively associated with performance.We further show that higher EI is associated with attenuated behavioral biases in trading, including the round number heuristic and the disposition effect.

title: Microclimate Risks and Consumer Adaptation
Pay Now, Buy Never: The Economics of Consumer Prepayment Schemes
abstract: Prepaid consumption is a common feature of modern consumer markets and is often presented as a mutually beneficial arrangement: consumers receive upfront discounts, and firms secure future sales.We analyze a large-scale Pay Now, Buy Later (PNBL) program in which consumers prepay for restaurant credit with bonuses, and spend the balance later.Using detailed transaction data from over 4 million consumers, we document widespread balance breakage: approximately 40% of prepaid value is never used.Because many consumers underutilize their balances, merchants recover significantly more than the bonus cost.The median firm earns roughly $5.5 in breakage profit for every $1 of bonus credit issued.While PNBL participation does lead to modest increases in consumer spending over time, firms gain substantially more from breakage than from any loyalty-driven revenue.These findings challenge the prevailing win-win narrative: PNBL schemes often result in a significant transfer from consumers to firms.We develop a stylized contract model to illustrate the misaligned incentives firms face, and show through counterfactual analysis that a simple escrow policy with an appropriately chosen deposit requirement can realign firm incentives and generate more consumer-serving outcomes.

title: Trade, Trees, and Lives
abstract: This paper shows a cascading mechanism through which international trade-induced deforestation results in a decline of health outcomes in cities distant from where trade activities occur. We examine Brazil, which has ramped up agricultural export over the last two decades to meet rising global demand. Using a shift-share research design, we first show that export shocks cause substantial local agricultural expansion and a virtual one-for-one decline in forest cover. We then construct a dynamic area-of-effect model that predicts where atmospheric changes should be feltdue to loss of forests that would otherwise serve to filter out and absorb air pollutants as they travel -downwind of the deforestation areas. Leveraging quasi-random variation in these atmospheric connections, we establish a causal link between deforestation upstream and subsequent rises in air pollution and premature deaths downstream, with the mortality effects predominantly driven by cardiovascular and respiratory causes. Our estimates reveal a large telecoupled health externality of trade deforestation: over 700,000 premature deaths in Brazil over the past two decades. This equates to $0.18 loss in statistical life value per $1 agricultural exports over the study period.
abstract_zh: 本文揭示了一种级联机制，通过该机制，国际贸易引发的森林砍伐会导致远离贸易活动发生地的城市居民健康状况下降。我们以巴西为研究对象，该国在过去二十年间大力扩大农产品出口，以满足全球不断增长的需求。采用份额-结构（shift-share）研究设计，我们首先表明，出口冲击会引起显著的本地农业扩张，并导致森林覆盖几乎等量的减少。随后，我们构建了一个动态影响区域模型，用以预测由于森林损失，大气变化会在何处显现——这些森林原本会在污染物随风输送时过滤并吸收空气污染物，而这些地点位于砍伐区域的下风向。利用这些大气联系中的准随机变异，我们建立了上游森林砍伐与下游空气污染及过早死亡上升之间的因果联系，其中死亡效应主要由心血管和呼吸系统原因所驱动。我们的估计表明，贸易引发的森林砍伐存在巨大的远程耦合健康外部性：在过去二十年间，巴西因此过早死亡人数超过70万。这相当于在研究期间，每出口1美元农产品，统计生命价值损失0.18美元。

title: Economic Activity and Biodiversity in the United States
abstract: The environmental impacts of economic activities extend beyond those directly affecting humans. This paper provides new evidence on the link between economic activity and ecosystem decline using a novel dataset that compiles longitudinal ecological sampling information at tens of thousands of locations across the United States between 1960 and 2015. Local shocks in economic activities, such as those driven by national military buildups, led to a significant reduction in species abundance, diversity, and stability, with one-third of the observed effects explained by the causal impact of air pollution. Government environmental regulations significantly mitigated pollution externalities. • We provide the first causal estimates of how economic activity reduces ecosystem biodiversity across taxa, using national military buildup shocks as quasi-exogenous variation. • Our analysis leverages millions of ecological observations from the BioTIME database, which allow us to construct longitudinal measures of species abundance, richness, and stability across the U.S. from 1960 to 2015. • We identify air pollution as a key causal channel, showing it accounts for about a third of the biodiversity impact from economic shocks using an upwind pollution IV strategy. • Environmental regulations such as the Clean Air Act significantly mitigate biodiversity losses, suggesting economic policies that protect human health also confer large ecological co-benefits.
abstract_zh: 经济活动的环境影响超出了直接影响人类的范畴。本文利用一个新数据集，为经济活动与生态系统衰退之间的联系提供了新的证据。该数据集汇集了1960年至2015年间美国数万个地点的纵向生态抽样信息。经济活动的局部冲击（例如由全国性军备扩张所驱动的冲击）导致物种丰度、多样性和稳定性显著下降，其中三分之一的观测效应可由空气污染的因果影响所解释。政府的环境监管显著缓解了污染外部性。•我们首次利用全国性军备扩张冲击作为准外生变异，提供了经济活动如何减少各类群生态系统生物多样性的因果估计。•我们的分析利用了数百万条生态观测数据，这些数据使我们能够构建1960年至2015年间美国物种丰度、丰富度和稳定性的纵向指标。•我们将空气污染确定为关键的因果渠道，并利用上风向污染工具变量策略表明，其约占经济冲击所致生物多样性影响的三分之一。•《清洁空气法》等环境法规显著减轻了生物多样性损失，这表明保护人类健康的经济政策也带来了巨大的生态协同效益。

title: The Nonlinear Effects of Air Pollution on Health: Evidence from Wildfire Smoke
abstract: We estimate how acute air pollution exposure from wildfire smoke impacts human health in the U.S., allowing for nonlinear effects. Wildfire smoke is pervasive and produces air quality shocks of varying intensity, depending on wind patterns and plume thickness. Using administrative Medicare records for 2007-2019, we estimate that wildfire smoke accounts for 18% of ambient PM2.5 concentrations, 0.42% of deaths, and 0.69% of emergency room visits among adults aged 65 and over. Smaller pollution shocks have outsized health impacts, indicating significant health benefits from improving air quality, even in areas meeting current regulatory standards.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了野火烟雾所造成的急性空气污染暴露如何影响美国居民的健康，并允许存在非线性效应。野火烟雾普遍存在，并会根据风向和烟羽厚度，造成强度各异的空气质量冲击。利用2007至2019年的医疗保险（Medicare）行政记录，我们估计，在65岁及以上成年人中，野火烟雾占环境PM2.5浓度的18%，占死亡人数的0.42%，占急诊就诊人次的0.69%。较小的污染冲击会产生不成比例的健康影响，这表明改善空气质量会带来显著的健康效益，即使是在已达到现行监管标准的地区。

title: Urban Forests: Environmental Health Values and Risks
abstract: Urban forests are ubiquitous, yet their impacts and values remain largely unknown. We study a massive urban afforestation policy in Beijing that planted 1/3 of a million acres of greenery in less than a decade. We conduct a remote-sensing audit of the program, finding that it contributes to a substantial greening up of the city. This causes significant downwind air quality improvement, reducing average PM2.5 concentration at city population hubs by 4.2%. Rapid vegetation growth unexpectedly led to a 7.4% increase in pollen exposure. Analysis of medical claims data shows that increased aeroallergens triggered emergency room visits, mirroring pollution effects though much less severe. Monetized net health benefits of the program amount to 1.5% of the city’s GDP. Urban forests are only partially capitalized in housing values, with buyers mainly appreciating proximity to green spaces but not the air quality improvements they bring.
abstract_zh: 城市森林无处不在，但其影响和价值在很大程度上仍不为人知。我们研究了北京一项大规模城市造林政策，该政策在不到十年的时间内种植了三分之一百万英亩的绿化植被。我们对该项目进行了遥感审计，发现它显著提升了城市的绿化水平。这带来了显著的下风向空气质量改善，使城市人口聚集区的平均PM2.5浓度降低了4.2%。植被的快速生长意外地导致花粉暴露增加了7.4%。医疗理赔数据分析表明，空气过敏原的增加引发了急诊就诊，其影响与污染效应相似，但程度要轻得多。该项目货币化后的净健康效益相当于该市GDP的1.5%。城市森林只在一定程度上被资本化于房屋价值之中，购房者主要看重靠近绿地的便利，而未充分体现其带来的空气质量改善。

title: Marine Microplastics and Infant Health
venue: Working Paper (reject and resubmit, Review of Economics and Statistics)
abstract: A century of plastic usage has led to an accumulation of plastic waste in waterways and oceans. Over time, these wastes break down into particles smaller than 5 microns -or "microplastics"which can infiltrate human biological systems. Despite decades of research into this emerging source of environmental pollution, there is a lack of direct evidence on the health impacts of microplastics exposure at a population scale. This paper reports the first causal link between inutero microplastic exposure and adverse birth outcomes. Our analysis is based on a compiled dataset of 3 million births that occurred in coastal areas of 15 countries spanning four continents, which we merge with a novel remote-sensing measurement of marine microplastic concentrations. We show that in-utero exposure to microplastics, particularly during the third trimester of pregnancy, leads to a significant increase in the likelihood of low birth weight.A doubling of exposure increases low birth weight hazard by 0.37 per 1,000 births, which implies over 205,000 cases per year globally can be attributed to microplastic exposure. We further show that aerosolization -whereby microplastic particles become airborne and inhalable due to seawater evaporation -is an important pathway for health impact, a challenge that is likely to escalate as ocean temperatures continue to rise.
abstract_zh: 一个世纪的塑料使用，导致塑料废弃物在水道和海洋中不断积累。随着时间推移，这些废弃物会分解成直径小于5微米的颗粒，即“微塑料”，它们可以渗入人体生物系统。尽管对这一新兴环境污染来源已进行了数十年的研究，但关于微塑料暴露对人群规模健康影响的直接证据仍然缺乏。本文报告了宫内微塑料暴露与不良出生结局之间的首个因果联系。我们的分析基于一个汇总数据集，包含来自四大洲15个国家沿海地区的300万例出生，并与一项新的海洋微塑料浓度遥感测量数据相结合。我们表明，宫内暴露于微塑料，尤其是在妊娠晚期，会显著增加低出生体重的可能性。暴露量每增加一倍，低出生体重的风险就增加每1000例出生0.37例，这意味着全球每年有超过20.5万例病例可归因于微塑料暴露。我们还表明，气溶胶化——即海水蒸发使微塑料颗粒悬浮于空中并可被吸入——是造成健康影响的重要途径，而随着海洋温度持续上升，这一挑战很可能会加剧。

title: Mobilizing Green Support through Digital Technology
abstract: A central challenge in the climate crisis is how to mobilize collective action-and who can do it. We show that digital platforms can transform latent support for sustainability into measurable environmental outcomes, while also generating value for the platform itself. We study Ant Forest, a program embedded in Alipay, China's leading fintech app, which rewards users' low-carbon behaviors with game points redeemable for planting real trees in arid regions of the country. Since its launch in 2016, the program has engaged over 700 million users and funded the planting of 500 million trees. Using user-level data, we find that participation is significantly higher in cities that have experienced faster vegetation growth. We propose a "green experience" mechanism: visible environmental improvement fosters greater appreciation for nature and increases support for sustainability efforts elsewhere. Survey evidence supports this mechanism, with participants also citing gamification and warm glow as key motivators. We further document spillover effects: Ant Forest participation boosts donations to external environmental projects and increases overall use of the Alipay app. These findings highlight the potential of digital platforms to scale climate action while creating shared environmental and economic value.
abstract_zh: 应对气候危机的核心挑战在于如何动员集体行动，以及由谁来推动。我们表明，数字平台可以将对可持续发展的潜在支持转化为可衡量的环境成果，同时也为平台自身创造价值。我们研究了蚂蚁森林，这是嵌入中国领先金融科技应用支付宝中的一个项目，它以游戏积分奖励用户的低碳行为，积分可兑换为在国内干旱地区种植的真实树木。自2016年推出以来，该项目已吸引了超过7亿用户参与，并资助种植了5亿棵树。利用用户层面的数据，我们发现，在植被生长较快的城市，参与度显著更高。我们提出了一种“绿色体验”机制：可见的环境改善会增进人们对自然的珍视，并增强对其他地方可持续发展努力的支持。调查证据支持这一机制，参与者还将游戏化和“暖光效应”（warm glow）列为主要动机。我们进一步记录了溢出效应：蚂蚁森林的参与提高了对外部环保项目的捐赠，并增加了支付宝应用的整体使用量。这些发现凸显了数字平台在扩大气候行动规模、同时创造共享环境与经济价值方面的潜力。

title: Air Pollution and the Labor Market: Evidence from Wildfire Smoke
abstract: We study how air pollution impacts the U.S. labor market by analyzing the effects of drifting wildfire smoke. We link satellite-based smoke plume data with labor market outcomes to estimate that an additional day of smoke exposure reduces quarterly earnings by about 0.1%. Extensive margin responses, including employment reductions and labor force exits, explain 13% of the overall earnings losses. The implied welfare costs from lost earnings due to air pollution exposure is on par with standard valuations of the mortality burden. The findings highlight the importance of labor market channels in air pollution policy responses.
abstract_zh: 我们通过分析漂移野火烟雾的影响，研究空气污染如何影响美国劳动力市场。我们将基于卫星的烟羽数据与劳动力市场结果相联系，估计每多一天烟雾暴露会使季度收入减少约0.1%。广义边际上的反应，包括就业减少和劳动力退出，解释了总收入损失的13%。空气污染暴露导致的收入损失所隐含的福利成本，与标准的死亡负担估值相当。这些发现凸显了劳动力市场渠道在空气污染政策应对中的重要性。

title: From Fog to Smog: The Value of Pollution Information
abstract: During 2013-2014, China launched a nationwide, real-time air quality monitoring and disclosure program, a watershed moment in the history of its environmental regulations. We present the first empirical analysis of this natural experiment by exploiting its staggered implementation across cities. The program has transformed the landscape of China's environmental protection, substantially expanded public access to pollution information, and dramatically increased households' awareness about pollution issues. These transformations, in turn, triggered a cascade of household behavioral changes, including increases in online searches for pollution-related topics, adjustments in day-to-day consumption patterns to avoid pollution exposure, and higher willingness to pay for housing in less polluted areas. As a result of both short- and long-term behavioral changes, the program significantly reduced the mortality impact of air pollution. Conservative estimates suggest that health benefits are at least one order of magnitude larger than the costs of the program and associated avoidance behaviors combined. Our findings highlight considerable benefits from improving access to pollution information in developing countries, many of which are experiencing the world's worst air pollution but do not systematically collect or disseminate pollution information.
abstract_zh: 2013年至2014年间，中国启动了全国性的实时空气质量监测与信息披露计划，这是其环境监管史上的分水岭。我们利用该计划在各城市交错实施的特点，首次对这一自然实验进行了实证分析。该计划改变了中国环境保护的面貌，大幅扩展了公众获取污染信息的渠道，并显著提高了家庭对污染问题的认识。这些转变进而引发了一系列家庭行为变化，包括与污染相关主题的网络搜索量增加、为避免污染暴露而调整日常消费模式，以及对于在污染较轻地区购房的支付意愿提高。受短期与长期行为变化的共同影响，该计划显著降低了空气污染的死亡率影响。保守估计表明，其健康效益至少比该计划及相关规避行为的总成本大一个数量级。我们的发现凸显了在发展中国家改善污染信息获取所具有的可观效益，许多发展中国家正经历着世界上最严重的空气污染，却并未系统地收集或发布污染信息。

title: 'Quick Response' Economic Stimulus: The Effect of Small-Value Digital Coupons on Spending
abstract: We study a new consumption stimulus program implemented by a large Chinese city that leverages mobile payment platforms to dispense massive amounts of small-value digital coupons. Exploiting a “rush” design of the dispensing process in which over 1 million program participants compete for coupons on a first-come, first-served basis through a digital portal, we estimate that winning coupons increases weekly out-of-pocket spending by US$3 for every US$1 in government subsidy. Coupon-winning consumers practice inter-temporal substitution by moving up purchases that would have been made four months in the future. Customer flow analysis suggests that coupons distort consumption toward pricier options. (JEL D15, E21, E42, H71, O18, P25, P36)

title: (Re)scheduling Pollution Exposure: The Case of Surgery Schedules and Patient Mortality
abstract: Many human activities can be strategically timed around forecastable natural hazards to mute their impacts. We study air pollution shock mitigation in a high-stakes healthcare setting: hospital surgery scheduling. Using newly available inpatient surgery records from a major city in China, we track post-surgery survival for over 1 million patients, and document a significant increase of hospital mortality among those who underwent surgeries on days with high particulate matter pollution. This effect has two special features. First, pollution on the surgery day, rather than exposure prior to hospitalization, before or after the surgery, is primarily explanatory of the excess mortality. Second, a small but high-risk group -elderly patients undergoing respiratory or cancer operations -bears a majority of pollution's damages. Based on these empirical findings, we analyze a model of hospital surgery scheduling. For over a third of the high-risk surgeries, there exists an alternative, lower-pollution day within three days such that moving the surgery may lead to a Pareto improvement in survival.
abstract_zh: 许多人类活动可以围绕可预测的自然灾害进行战略性安排，以减轻其影响。我们研究医院手术安排这一高风险医疗场景中的空气污染冲击缓解问题。利用中国某大城市新近可获得的住院手术记录，我们追踪了逾100万名患者的术后存活情况，并记录到在颗粒物污染严重的日子里接受手术的患者，其住院死亡率显著上升。这一效应具有两个特点。第一，手术当天的污染，而非入院前、术前或术后的暴露，是超额死亡的主要解释因素。第二，一小部分高风险人群——接受呼吸系统或癌症手术的老年患者——承受了污染所造成的大部分损害。基于这些实证发现，我们分析了一个医院手术安排模型。对于超过三分之一的高风险手术，存在三天之内的替代性低污染日，将手术移至该日可能带来存活率的帕累托改进。

title: China's War on Pollution: Evidence from the First 5 Years
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: The decade from 2010 to 2019 marked a significant turning point in China’s approach to environmental regulation and pollution. This article describes the recent trends in air and water quality, with a focus on the 5 years following the Chinese government’s announcement of its “war on pollution” in 2014. We review the emerging literature that has taken advantage of recent improvements in data availability and accuracy to understand the social, economic, and health impacts of environmental pollution in China.
abstract_zh: 2010年至2019年这十年，标志着中国环境监管与污染治理方式的一个重要转折点。本文描述了近期空气和水质的变化趋势，重点关注中国政府于2014年宣布“向污染宣战”之后的五年。我们回顾了新兴文献，这些文献利用近期数据可得性和准确性的提升，来理解环境污染对中国社会、经济和健康的影响。

title: Unwatched Pollution: The Effect of Intermittent Monitoring on Air Quality
abstract: Intermittent monitoring of environmental standards may induce strategic changes in polluting activities. This paper documents local strategic responses to a cyclical, once-every-six-day air quality monitoring schedule under the federal Clean Air Act. Using satellite data of monitored areas, I show that air quality is significantly worse on unmonitored days. This effect is explained by short-term suppression of pollution on monitored days, especially during high-pollution periods when the city’s noncompliance risk is high. Cities’ use of air quality warnings increases on monitored days, which suggests local governments’ role in coordinating emission reductions. (JEL K32, Q35, Q58, R11)
abstract_zh: 对环境标准进行间歇性监测，可能会引发污染活动的战略性变化。本文记录了地方对联邦《清洁空气法》下每六天一次的周期性空气质量监测安排所作出的战略反应。利用受监测区域的卫星数据，我表明在未受监测的日子里空气质量明显更差。这一效应可以由受监测日子里污染的短期抑制来解释，尤其是在高污染时期，此时城市的不达标风险较高。城市在受监测日发布空气质量预警的频率有所增加，这表明地方政府在协调减排方面发挥了作用。（JEL K32, Q35, Q58, R11）

title: Conservation Co-Benefits from Air Pollution Regulation
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Massive wildlife losses over the past 50 years have brought new urgency to identifying both the drivers of population decline and potential solutions. We provide the first large-scale evidence that air pollution, specifically ozone, is associated with declines in bird abundance in the United States. We show that an air pollution regulation limiting ozone precursors emissions has delivered substantial benefits to bird conservation. Our estimates imply that air quality improvements over the past four decades have stemmed the decline in bird populations, averting the loss of 1.5 billion birds, approximately 20 percent of current totals. Our results highlight that in addition to protecting human health, air pollution regulations have previously unrecognized and unquantified conservation co-benefits.
abstract_zh: 过去50年间，大规模的野生动物损失使人们迫切需要找出种群减少的驱动因素及潜在解决方案。我们首次提供了大规模证据，表明空气污染，特别是臭氧，与美国鸟类数量的减少相关。我们表明，一项限制臭氧前体物排放的空气污染法规，为鸟类保护带来了实质性效益。我们的估计表明，过去四十年间空气质量的改善遏制了鸟类种群的减少，避免了15亿只鸟类的损失，约占当前总数的20%。我们的结果表明，除了保护人类健康之外，空气污染法规还具有以往未被认识到、也未被量化的保护协同效益。

title: Emergency Visits for Thunderstorm-Related Respiratory Illnesses Among Older Adults
abstract: Thunderstorm-related atmospheric changes are expected to increase in severity with rising global temperatures.1 Although large-scale evidence is limited, vulnerable populations, such as older adults or those with common chronic respiratory diseases, like asthma or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), are expected to be susceptible to negative health effects from these changes. 2 The objective of this study was to determine whether increases in emergency department (ED) visits for acute respiratory illnesses occur among Medicare beneficiaries in the days surrounding thunderstorms across the continental US.
abstract_zh: 随着全球气温上升，与雷暴相关的大气变化预计将日益严重。尽管大规模证据有限，但老年人或患有哮喘、慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）等常见慢性呼吸系统疾病的弱势群体，预计易受这些变化的负面健康影响。本研究的目的是确定，在美国大陆地区雷暴前后数日，医疗保险受益人是否会因急性呼吸道疾病而增加急诊科（ED）就诊。

title: Wind Turbine Syndrome: The Impact of Wind Farms on Suicide
